subject: SummitAI: schedule 30min demo + ops/stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@summitai.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: SummitAI: schedule 30min demo + ops/stakeholder alignment

Hi Lina —

Great to meet you and Ravi on today’s call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

- Summary: You’re evaluating inference cost and latency for SummitAI’s real‑time summarization pipeline; primary goals are predictable 95th‑percentile latency and lower per‑token cost for inference.
- Key stakeholders to include: Ravi (CTO) — platform/infra; Maya (Head of ML) — model quality/ops; and an engineering owner to validate integration constraints.

Next step: 30‑minute product intro (high‑level + quick technical Q&A). Can you confirm which of the below windows works best for your team (all times PDT)? I’ve listed one option in the morning and two in the afternoon to cover typical schedules: 

Option A: Tue Jul 4, 10:00–10:30 AM PDT
Option B: Wed Jul 5, 2:00–2:30 PM PDT
Option C: Thu Jul 6, 4:00–4:30 PM PDT

If none work, tell me two time blocks that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. Also: can you confirm the technical attendee (name & email) so we bring the right SE?

Attached: product-demo-deck-v1.pdf (short 7‑slide overview). I’m also attaching a draft mutual action plan (will share once we agree attendees).

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0143
Redwood Inference

Attachments: product-demo-deck-v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@summitai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Desai <ravi.desai@summitai.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SummitAI: schedule 30min demo + ops/stakeholder alignment

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the recap — appreciated. Ravi and I confirmed who should join:
- Ravi Desai (CTO) — ravi.desai@summitai.com
- Maya Patel (Head of ML) — maya.patel@summitai.com (please include her for model‑quality discussion)
- I will also add our infra lead (Aaron Park) if the time syncs.

Preference: Option B (Wed Jul 5, 2:00–2:30 PM PDT) looks best for Ravi and Maya. If that slot fills, Option C is our secondary. Option A is difficult due to a leadership offsite.

We also like to see an ops checklist before the call so we can prep questions on data retention and regional routing. If you can drop a short one‑pager or link, that would be helpful.

Thanks — Lina
Lina Torres
Director, Platform Partnerships | SummitAI
lina.torres@summitai.com | +1 (206) 555‑0199

Thanks Lina — wed Jul 5 at 2:00 PM PDT works for us. I’ve tentatively held that slot on our side.

Quick operational notes and ask before I send the invite: 
- Can you confirm Aaron Park’s email if he’ll join? If not, we’ll proceed with Ravi and Maya and add Aaron ad‑hoc.
- I’m attaching a one‑page ops checklist and a draft mutual action plan for your review (mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx). It lists the basic integration milestones we typically track for a pilot: security review, network requirements, data retention, test dataset expectations.

Proposed meeting invite details (will send after confirmation):
- Wed, Jul 5, 2028 · 2:00–2:30 PM PDT
- Agenda: 10m product overview / 10m targeted technical Q&A / 10m next steps + MAP review
- SE attending: Grace O’Connor (solutions engineer) — grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

If that looks good reply “Confirm” and I’ll send a calendar invite with the deck attached.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx (Excel), ops-checklist-onepager.pdf (PDF - link: https://redwood.app/s/ops-checklist-8921)
